prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1168; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision described in the claim you have opened under the reference number on your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. Any request for a statement, recorded or otherwise, must also be routed through us.

We ask that you provide the complete policy limits for all liability coverage applicable to the insured driver, including any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply, along with a copy of the declarations page. Please confirm this information in writing within fourteen days of receipt of this letter.

We also request that the insurer preserve all evidence relating to the incident. This includes photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, vehicle telematics, repair estimates, adjuster notes, recorded statements, and any claim file materials. Please ensure that no vehicle involved in the collision is repaired, salvaged, or disposed of until our office has had an opportunity to inspect it.
